bundle.shortDescription: Build, wire, program and test boards and machines in 3D
bundle.longDescription: Bench Workshop is a 3D workbench with physics. Put parts together, wire boards, program them (Arduino-style sketches or real RP2040 firmware), run it and see if it works before building it for real.
